scope: Only the nearest upper-right hanging lamp, original call lantern(7.7,7.3,21.6,1.35,true). The left and behind-camera hanging lamps and every smaller fixture retain their original generator.
source: Original editable closed geometry in src/hero-hanging-lantern.js; no external mesh, generated bitmap, image model or AI height guide.
comparison: references/hd/8-照片-9.jpg, upper-right lamp. Photograph remains a comparison input under its original copyright; no pixels are copied into scene materials or geometry.

geometry.units: Assembly local metres multiplied by original 1.35*0.88 factor
geometry.window: Closed 18 mm eight-petal pierced bronze mask with bevels; four curved corner vines connect it to fine solid jambs. Four original paper boxes retain exact size, transform, material and emission.
geometry.frame: 28 mm corner columns with separate shoes, 22 mm inner jambs, 23 mm rails, pierced upper and lower aprons and rolled cornice. Dimensions are structural inference, not claimed metric measurements of the photograph.
geometry.capAndSuspension: Closed square-section shallow cap replaces block pyramid; thinner 6 mm radius chain stock retains original outer ring radius and vertical limits. Original external suspension above the assembly remains unchanged.
geometry.underside: Closed annular rims, open four-brace cradle, a central collar and five small turned drops replace solid black four-sided cone. No new luminous pane or light source.
geometry.normals: Flat load-bearing bronze cap facets, smooth turned drops and true narrow bevels at sheet edges. No alpha-mask or normal-map imitation of perforations.

privateMetalSurface.method: Original deterministic 128x128 scalar micrograin DataTextures, only roughness and 0.22/0.12 mm bump; independent bronze/brass pigment. No photograph colors or AI raster.

retained.paper: Original M.paper object, fiber maps, attenuation, color and emissive intensity unmodified

limitations: Interpretive one-component construction; reference bloom and apron carving are not exactly surveyed. Actual native full/detail review is mandatory and whole scene remains unaccepted.
